finding.summary: A product file or its parent could be replaced by a symlink after wrapper validation but before the base transaction's internal resolve/filesystem boundary, allowing the base path logic to follow a late alias.
finding.reproducer: plain target passes wrapper validation -> swap final target or parent to symlink -> old Path.resolve follows alias

fix.mechanism: guarded lexical Path revalidates the whole alias-free chain at base resolve() and os.fspath() filesystem boundaries; external targets are not authorized by late alias substitution

scenarios: final target swapped to symlink after wrapper validation
parent directory swapped to symlink before base resolve
parent directory swapped after resolve and before filesystem boundary

product_pair.reason: root safety fix landed first; fresh canonical check/apply/readback/compile and full Agent matrix are still required on agent_after
